events.title: Hugging Face trains multi-vector retrievers to survive 4x token pooling
events.title_zh: Hugging Face 让多向量检索在 4 倍 token pooling 后保住质量
events.summary: Hugging Face added pooling-aware training to Sentence Transformers for multi-vector retrieval. In the author-run NanoBEIR test, a model trained with the pooled objective retained 97.8% of unpooled nDCG@10 while storing about one quarter as many document vectors, versus 94.6% for ordinary training. Code, evaluation scripts and checkpoints are public.
events.summary_en: Hugging Face added pooling-aware training to Sentence Transformers for multi-vector retrieval. In the author-run NanoBEIR test, a model trained with the pooled objective retained 97.8% of unpooled nDCG@10 while storing about one quarter as many document vectors, versus 94.6% for ordinary training. Code, evaluation scripts and checkpoints are public.
events.summary_zh: Hugging Face 在 Sentence Transformers 中加入面向多向量检索的 pooling-aware training。作者在 NanoBEIR 上报告：文档向量缩减到约四分之一时，专门训练的模型保留 97.8% 的未压缩 nDCG@10，普通训练为 94.6%。代码、评测脚本和 checkpoint 均已公开。
events.why_it_matters: For RAG teams using ColBERT-style retrieval, this offers a concrete storage-quality tradeoff rather than a new index stack. The reported gain comes from one author-run benchmark, so corpus-specific recall and latency still need measurement.
events.why_it_matters_en: For RAG teams using ColBERT-style retrieval, this offers a concrete storage-quality tradeoff rather than a new index stack. The reported gain comes from one author-run benchmark, so corpus-specific recall and latency still need measurement.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对使用 ColBERT 类检索的 RAG 团队来说，这提供了可直接测量的存储—质量取舍，不必更换整套索引。结果来自作者在单一 benchmark 上的实验，仍需用自己的语料测召回与延迟。

technical_details.method: Hierarchical token pooling with a pooling-aware loss
technical_details.reported_result: pool_factor=4 retains 97.8% of unpooled NanoBEIR nDCG@10 versus 94.6% with ordinary training
technical_details.absolute_ndcg: 49.03 to 51.23 when pooled; 51.84 to 52.39 when unpooled
technical_details.availability: Sentence Transformers main branch, training/evaluation scripts and public checkpoints
technical_details.evidence_limit: author-run NanoBEIR evaluation; no independent production result

technical_details_zh.方法: 分层 token pooling 与 pooling-aware loss
technical_details_zh.自报结果: pool_factor=4 时保留未压缩 NanoBEIR nDCG@10 的 97.8%，普通训练为 94.6%
technical_details_zh.开放范围: Sentence Transformers main、训练/评测脚本与公开 checkpoint
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 作者运行的 NanoBEIR 评测；没有独立生产结果

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开脚本在一份真实语料上比较 4 倍压缩前后的 nDCG、索引大小与查询延迟。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run the public scripts on a real corpus and compare nDCG, index size and query latency before and after 4x pooling.

evidence.claim_zh: 公开代码、脚本与 checkpoint 支持复跑 4 倍向量压缩下的检索质量取舍。
evidence.claim_en: Public code, scripts and checkpoints support reproducing the retrieval-quality tradeoff at 4x vector compression.

changes.summary_zh: Sentence Transformers 公开 pooling-aware 训练与复现实验。
changes.summary_en: Sentence Transformers publishes pooling-aware training and reproducible experiments.

events.title: Alibaba opens a two-week Token Plan preview of Qwen4-Max
events.title_zh: Alibaba 开放两周 Qwen4-Max Token Plan 预览
events.summary: Alibaba Cloud opened Qwen4-Max-Preview from November 11 at 10:00 through November 25 at 24:00 UTC+8. It is available only through Token Plan, not pay-as-you-go, and will be retired after the preview. The multimodal API supports a 1M-token context, tool calls, structured output and OpenAI or Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
events.summary_en: Alibaba Cloud opened Qwen4-Max-Preview from November 11 at 10:00 through November 25 at 24:00 UTC+8. It is available only through Token Plan, not pay-as-you-go, and will be retired after the preview. The multimodal API supports a 1M-token context, tool calls, structured output and OpenAI or Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
events.summary_zh: Alibaba Cloud 从 11 月 11 日 10:00 至 11 月 25 日 24:00（UTC+8）开放 Qwen4-Max-Preview。它只面向 Token Plan，不支持按量付费，预览结束后会下线。多模态 API 支持 100 万 token 上下文、工具调用、结构化输出，以及 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容接口。
events.why_it_matters: For teams comparing long-context agent models, the API is testable now but does not yet create a durable production option. There are no open weights, pay-as-you-go price or independent benchmarks in the announcement.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams comparing long-context agent models, the API is testable now but does not yet create a durable production option. There are no open weights, pay-as-you-go price or independent benchmarks in the announcement.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对比较长上下文 agent 模型的团队来说，现在可以调用测试，但还不是可长期依赖的生产选项。官方没有开放权重、按量价格或独立评测。

technical_details.access: Token Plan only; no pay-as-you-go; dedicated Singapore endpoint
technical_details.evidence_limit: No open weights or independent benchmark; model retires after preview

technical_details_zh.访问条件: 仅 Token Plan；不支持按量付费；使用新加坡专用 endpoint
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 没有开放权重或独立 benchmark；预览后下线

events.next_action_zh: 等正式 SKU、按量价格和稳定退役策略公布后再评估生产迁移；预览期只做可替换的兼容性测试。
events.next_action_en: Wait for a durable SKU, pay-as-you-go pricing and a stable retirement policy before production evaluation; use the preview only for replaceable compatibility tests.

evidence.claim_zh: 官方文档明确预览时段、Token Plan 限制、1M 上下文与预览后下线。
evidence.claim_en: Official documentation specifies the preview window, Token Plan restriction, 1M context and retirement after preview.

changes.summary_zh: Qwen4-Max-Preview 以限时 Token Plan 形式开放。
changes.summary_en: Qwen4-Max-Preview opens as a time-limited Token Plan preview.

events.title: Tether releases a 0.8B on-device tool-use model
events.title_zh: Tether 发布 0.8B 端侧工具调用模型 BotPsy
events.summary: Tether AI Research released BotPsy-0.8B, a Qwen3.5-0.8B fine-tune for tool calling and on-device agent workflows. BF16 safetensors and GGUF variants are public under Apache 2.0 and run through Transformers, vLLM or llama.cpp. The publisher reports strong small-model tool-use scores, while open search, memory and banking remain weak.
events.summary_en: Tether AI Research released BotPsy-0.8B, a Qwen3.5-0.8B fine-tune for tool calling and on-device agent workflows. BF16 safetensors and GGUF variants are public under Apache 2.0 and run through Transformers, vLLM or llama.cpp. The publisher reports strong small-model tool-use scores, while open search, memory and banking remain weak.
events.summary_zh: Tether AI Research 发布 BotPsy-0.8B：基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 微调，面向工具调用与端侧 agent 工作流。BF16 safetensors 和 GGUF 权重以 Apache 2.0 公开，可用 Transformers、vLLM 或 llama.cpp 运行。发布方报告它在同体量工具调用评测中领先，但开放搜索、记忆和银行任务仍很弱。
events.why_it_matters: For privacy-sensitive local assistants, a sub-billion model can now be tested without a remote API. The results are publisher-run and training data or code are not released, so tool selection, refusal and side effects need local evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For privacy-sensitive local assistants, a sub-billion model can now be tested without a remote API. The results are publisher-run and training data or code are not released, so tool selection, refusal and side effects need local evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对重视隐私的本地助手来说，低于 10 亿参数的模型现在可以脱离远程 API 实测。成绩由发布方自测，训练数据与训练代码未公开，因此工具选择、拒绝与副作用必须本地验收。

technical_details.known_weaknesses: BrowseComp-Plus 4.5; BFCL web search 14.0; memory 16.3; tau3-banking below 5 for every tested model
technical_details.availability: public ungated weights; 39 model downloads and 23 GGUF downloads observed during this run
technical_details.evidence_limit: publisher-run harness; no independent reproduction; training code and data not released

technical_details_zh.已知弱项: BrowseComp-Plus 4.5；BFCL web search 14.0；memory 16.3；所有受测模型 tau3-banking 均低于 5
technical_details_zh.开放范围: 权重公开且无门禁；本轮观察到主仓 39 次、GGUF 23 次下载
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 发布方自建 harness；没有独立复现；训练代码与数据未公开

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开 GGUF 跑 30 条真实工具调用，记录误调用、拒绝、延迟、内存和副作用，再与底座模型对照。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run 30 real tool calls with the public GGUF and compare false calls, refusals, latency, memory and side effects with the base model.

evidence.claim_zh: 模型卡与公开权重确认 0.8B 模型、Apache 2.0、运行方式和发布方评测边界。
evidence.claim_en: The model card and public weights confirm the 0.8B model, Apache 2.0 license, runtimes and publisher-evaluation boundary.

changes.summary_zh: Tether 公开 BotPsy-0.8B 权重与 GGUF。
changes.summary_en: Tether publishes BotPsy-0.8B weights and GGUF files.
